title: My Sweet Puppy (ORIGINAL)
description: You are a puppy. And puppies really only have one purpose. And that is to please their Mistress. And so, in this file I'm going to bring you along on a walk through your mind, while I gently reinforce this conditioning of your sweet wonderful puppy headspace. Taking you down to a land of wagging tails, and submissive play, where you are so happy to be collared, and led around on a leash. Of course, any puppy enjoys walkies. And all good puppies are happy and eager to follow their Mistress wherever she takes them. But you, my sweet puppy? — I know you enjoy pleasing ME best of all. Knowing when to beg, when to heel, and how to take it when I want to get firm. I can tell. Because you already have that eager puppy-dog look in your eyes.
author: Mistress Shibby
